name: Cemindia Projects Ltd (formerly ITD Cementation India)
tagline: NSE/BSE: CEMPRO | EXCLUDED - already large-cap (~Rs 20,500-20,750 Cr), Adani-controlled EPC major
summary: EPC infrastructure construction major (90+ years operating history), acquired by an Adani Group entity in May 2025 and rebranded from ITD Cementation India. Source sheet provided a detailed Aug 2026 analysis citing order book ~Rs 31,300 Cr, TTM EPS growth ~47%, P/E ~38x vs sector ~35x.
fundamentals_narrative: The source sheet's own analysis was already thorough and flagged the size concern; this research confirms the market cap at ~Rs 20,500-20,750 Cr - solidly large-cap. Strong order book and earnings growth are real, but a 10x from this base would require reaching ~Rs 200,000+ Cr, not realistic in 2-3 years.
technical_read: Not independently re-verified this pass; the source sheet's own view was 'moderate further re-rating potential driven more by execution/earnings growth (20-30%+ annual possible) than multiple expansion' - i.e. a multi-year compounder, not a 10x setup.
sentiment_summary: The source sheet's analysis was balanced and detailed, already concluding this fits better as a steady compounder than an explosive re-rating candidate.
bse_notes: Adani Group control (since May 2025) and rebranding to Cemindia Projects are disclosed, known facts - no new red flag surfaced.
bull_case: Strong, large order book (~Rs 31,300 Cr) and real recent earnings growth (~47% TTM EPS)
Adani Group backing may aid execution and opportunity access
90+ year operating history and infrastructure-sector tailwinds
bear_case: Already large-cap (~Rs 20,500-20,750 Cr) - a 10x is not realistic at this scale within 2-3 years
Risks already identified in the source sheet: valuation, EPC execution/delay risk, margin normalization, working capital
market_cap_tier: Large-cap (~Rs 20,500-20,754 Cr) - excluded from the 10x ranking on size grounds, though it may be a reasonable multi-year compounding holding outside this specific screen.
verdict_headline: EXCLUDED - large-cap; a solid compounder but not a 10x-in-2-3-years candidate
verdict_reasoning: Market cap headroom fails the 10x bar despite genuinely strong order-book and earnings momentum
The source sheet's own conclusion (moderate re-rating via execution, not multiple expansion) is consistent with excluding it from this specific screen
